parts.html: The K-09 kitchen model combines contemporary grey cabinetry, elegant glass fronts, natural quartzite and a functional kitchen island to create a refined residential interior.

Its straight-line configuration provides an organized arrangement of the main kitchen furniture, while the separate island introduces an additional surface for food preparation and everyday activities.

The defining feature of the K-09 design is the combination of glass upper cabinet fronts and painted lower cabinets. Glass elements introduce visual lightness, while the coordinated grey surfaces maintain a clean and contemporary architectural appearance.
A natural quartzite countertop complements the kitchen with distinctive stone textures, adding character to the understated color palette.
The combination of glass, painted surfaces and stone makes the K-09 model suitable for contemporary apartments, open-plan living spaces and private residences.
With a total linear length of 6.7 meters, the kitchen provides space for built-in appliances, practical work surfaces and organized cabinet storage.
The kitchen island adds flexibility to the layout and can serve as an additional preparation area within the interior.
For everyday convenience, the K-09 model includes a pull-out cargo storage system, helping organize kitchen essentials and make efficient use of available cabinet space.
The cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard. Hettich soft-close hinges and AvanTech YOU Hettich drawer systems provide smooth operation and comfortable access to stored items.
Cabinet handles are included in the configuration.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments and private residences in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-09 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, appliance requirements, storage preferences and architectural features.
Our services include personalized kitchen planning, material selection, cabinet manufacturing, delivery and professional installation.
Additional equipment, including kitchen sinks, built-in appliances, extractor hoods and plumbing fixtures, can be selected according to the client's requirements.
Order your K-09 kitchen from DUMSKAYA DESIGN and create a contemporary interior combining glass cabinetry, natural stone and functional kitchen island design.
